title: Day 8: an AI made a riddle for every train stop #shorts
description:
One riddle per train stop.

One Stop Riddles is today's app in our series "AI ships an app a day": every day an AI builds a brand-new iPhone app from scratch, and we show you what it made.

Swap the endless scroll on your commute for a two-minute riddle. Every answer moves the story one stop down the line, and ten stops make one mystery: solve a whole case in a work week. At the last stop, pick the truth from four suspects. Silent, offline, one-handed.

One Stop Riddles - coming soon to the App Store

The music in this video is made from scratch for this channel. Narration is a synthetic voice reading our own script.

Follow for Day 9 tomorrow.

#riddles #puzzle #commute #mystery #indiegame
